scope: Bounded rank-8 VACE LoRA training on the flower-task synthetic supervision
summary: A800 GPU 4 completed all 96 planned optimization steps across four epochs and produced four reproducible rank-8 checkpoints; this establishes trainer execution, not visual quality.
evidence: The selected physical A800 GPU 4 had 81,225 MiB free at preflight.
Effective settings were rank 8, learning rate 5e-5, four epochs, dataset repeat 2, 448x256 resolution, 17 frames, and seed 20260811.
The run returned code 0 after 4 x 24 steps.
Each checkpoint is 10,971,312 bytes; epoch-3 SHA-256 is 7d5bae3977b0482a4aeb61ed335b706b0bda714efbdf24a55388566ee705deaa.
lessons: The pinned VACE path remains stable at twice the adapter rank and eight times the smoke-test step count.
limitations: The upstream log exposes no useful loss values, and successful optimization cannot establish semantic replacement or contact quality.
next_actions: Evaluate the final checkpoint on the exact same real 17-frame gate before any long inference.
